Thanks for trying out IdleCorp! If you need help from our community or want to trade with other players, join our Discord server at https://discordapp.com/invite/N9CH9wV == Building a [[:Category:Facility|facility]] == Facilities will produce assets which you can sell for money!
- You can build new facilities with the $$build command. Try building a [[tree farm]] with
$$build tree farm
- You can build multiple at a time like this:
$$build tree farm 5
- Eventually, you'll have enough [[wood]] to build an [[iron mine]]
- You can see a list of '''your facilities''' with $$f
- You can see a list of '''all''' facilities you can build with $$faclist == Managing your [[:Category:Asset|assets]] == Assets are used by some facilities to manufacture new assets, or can be sold either to [[Market#NPC_market|NPCs]] or to [[Market#Player_market|other players]].
- You can check your current assets with $$a
- If you want to sell all of your [[wood]], you can use
$$sa wood
- If you want to buy some asset, [[iron]] for example, you can use
$$buy iron
- Once you've sold some assets, you can check your [[capital]] and other stats with
$$c
- You can check the current price of an asset like [[crude oil]] with
$$price oil
- You can get a list of the current prices of '''all''' assets with $$price == Regions == Each Discord Server is its own IdleCorp '''[[region]]''' where your corporation stores [[:Category:Asset|assets]] and builds [[:Category:Facility|facilities]].
- Assets that are produced in one region can only be accessed in that region (until you '''[[export]]''' them)
- However, your [[corporation]]'s money or '''capital is shared''' between all regions.
- Each region also has its own '''[[Region#Modifiers_(Facilities)|production modifiers]]''', '''[[:Category:Service|services]]''', and '''[[:Category:Policy|policies]]'''.
You can check these with $$r == There's more! == There's a ton more to IdleCorp that will take too long to explain now!
- There's a '''[[research]]''' system with random [[Blueprint|blueprints]] to be discovered,
- A purely player-driven '''[[market]]''' that you can trade in,
- '''Daily challenges''' to complete for your '''[[Season pass|Season Pass]]''',
- Regional [[:Category:Policy|policies]] and legislation that you can participate in,
and so much more!
